To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the entropic parameter depends on the geometrical and kinematical characteristics of the flow, and that the dependence is not linear.
the entropic parameter is not a constant but it depends on the flow conditions and on the geometrical and hydraulic sizes of the section.

“the entropic parameter is a good indicator of the geometrical and hydraulic conditions of steady free surface flows, in conditions of macro- and intermediate homogeneous roughnes, and its value can be estimated with good accuracy through the measurement of the flow depth and the slope”.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects:   1. the evaluation of the dependence of the entropy parameter on the flow geometry and the bed resistance;   2. the analysis of the effects of the bed resistance on the flow geometry;   3. the evaluation of a possible correlation between the entropic and the geometrical parameters.
the evaluation of the dependence of the flow geometry and morphology from the entropic parameter.

-the definition of the entropic parameters variability in different flow conditions; - the analysis of the entropic size variability in different flow sections, according to the geometrical and morphological conditions; - the definition of a new methodology to determine the outflows, through the measurement of the entropic sizes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the entropic parameter is a function of the flow resistance and of the flow geometry.
the entropic parameter is a good indicator of the section shape, but it is not able to describe the flow conditions.
the entropic parameter is a function of the Froude number and of the relative roughness.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the entropic parameter is a good index for the estimation of the hydraulic roughness, the flow depth and the Froude number, in a wide range of flow conditions.
, for a given flow condition, the entropic parameter depends on the flow geometry, and that the flow geometry depends on the entropic parameter.
the entropic parameter, as the ratio between the hydraulic and the geometrical resistance, can be used as a reliable and expeditive indicator of the flow conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the entropic parameter is a good indicator of the geometrical and morphological river conditions.
the entropic parameter is not only an intrinsic flow characteristic, but is also related to the flow geometry.
the entropic parameter is a good indicator of the flow geometry and morphology.
